meta.title: °C to K — Convert Celsius to Kelvin | Turbo Unit Converter
meta.description: Convert Celsius (°C) to Kelvin (K) instantly. 1 °C = 274.15 K. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert celsiuss (°C) to kelvins (K) instantly. Both measure temperature, so the relationship is strictly linear: each celsius equals 274.15 kelvins. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One celsius is equal to **274.15 kelvins**. To go the other way, one kelvin equals **-272.15 celsiuss**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> kelvins = celsiuss × 274.15

Worked example — converting 10 celsiuss:

10 × 274.15 = **283.15 K**.

To invert, divide by 274.15 (or multiply by -272.15).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 °C ≈ 274.15 K. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Celsius and Kelvin both measure temperature; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many kelvins are in 1 celsius?
**A:** 274.15 kelvins.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert °C to K?
**A:** kelvins = celsiuss × 274.15.

**Q:** How do I convert K back to °C?
**A:** Multiply by -272.15 (or divide by 274.15).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this °C to K converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
